title: The Euler Characteristic of Spherical Bestvina-Brady Kernels
summary: We compute the Euler characteristic of Bestvina-Brady kernels $\operatorname{BB}(Γ)$ for all Artin groups of spherical type. Our method involves discrete Morse theory to describe the cellular structure of a classifying space for the Bestvina--Brady kernel, through the action of $\operatorname{BB}(Γ)$ on non-integer level sets of the universal cover of the Salvetti complex.
